services.heading: What we do.
services.description: We build digital products from scratch — from visual identity to infrastructure.
services.stat_sub: Design, code and infrastructure. No middlemen, no surprises.

process.heading: How we work.
process.step_01_desc: We listen. We understand the business, context and goals before writing a single line of code.
process.step_02_desc: High-fidelity visual prototypes. Every decision has a reason behind it.
process.step_03_desc: Clean, semantic and performant code. No unnecessary frameworks, no shortcuts.
process.step_04_desc: Deploy, final testing and post-launch support. We stay by your side until everything works.

why.heading: A different studio.
why.item_01_desc: You talk directly with the people who design and write the code. No account managers, no broken telephone.
why.item_02_desc: Brand, interface, frontend, backend — everything from the same studio. No dependency on external vendors.
why.item_03_desc: Local roots, international standards. We've delivered for clients across 3 continents.

home.manifesto: We build software with roots. Interfaces that feel, products that last and code made with care, from Santiago to the world.

team.heading: The people behind Badiu.
team.description: A small studio of people who write code, design interfaces and love seeing ideas take shape. Everyone has their own portfolio.
team.join_description: We look for people who like to build things with care.
team.banner: We work together on every project: design, code and deploy at the same table.

member.stack_description: What I use day to day, from browser to server.

contact.heading: Got an idea?
contact.description: Tell us what you have in mind: a website, an app or a full product. We usually reply within 1 to 2 business days.
contact.error_message: Tell us a bit more (min. 10 characters).
